title: Derivatives and slope
text: Let’s locate where slope stops feeling familiar.

strands.assessment: You read the slope of a straight line and can compare two slopes.
The transition from average to instantaneous rate needs practice.

assessment.summary: Build the derivative from rates you can already compare.

text: That gives us a good starting point.

graph TD

text: We will compare ordinary slopes first, then use a limit to read the slope at a single point.

arguments.question: Which line rises faster?
arguments.explanation: Compare the change in height to the change in distance.

arguments.question: What does a secant line measure?
arguments.explanation: Compare the change in height to the change in distance.

text: A secant joins two points. Its slope gives the average rate of change between them.
Exactly. That average rate is the secant slope.
